name: pi-config
//workspaces: npm workspaces are intentionally NOT enabled. Extension packages are loaded directly by pi and verified by the root test/typecheck runners. Activating workspaces would require package.json files for every extension and would change root dependency installation. Track enabling this in docs/internal/code-review/TODO-archive.md.

scripts.check: npm run sync-models -- --check && npm run typecheck && npm --prefix extension run lint -- && npm run test:changed
scripts.verify: npm run sync-models -- --check && npm run typecheck && npm --prefix extension run lint -- && npm run test && npm run extension:build:after-typecheck
scripts.extensions:test: node ./scripts/run-tests.mjs --package ask-user --package cwd-skills --package safeguard --package skill-pruner --package subagent --package web-access-compat --package warm-bash --package tool-result-pruner --package session-reviewer --package session-changes --package deferred-triggers
scripts.extensions:typecheck: node ./scripts/run-typechecks.mjs --project ask-user --project cwd-skills --project safeguard --project skill-pruner --project web-access-compat --project warm-bash --project tool-result-pruner --project session-reviewer --project session-changes --project deferred-triggers
